Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 11, 2022

On Jul 5, 2022, enterprise full-scenario data-intelligence vendor Dipu Tech (滴普科技) (founded 2018) closed a ¥110M Series B+ led by AVIC Industry-Finance, with returning top LPs — 8th round — to deepen aviation/advanced manufacturing and critical-industry clients. Lakehouse data-intelligence unicorn: cloud-native + data mid-platform stacking 5G/IoT/big data/AI/cloud into BI + industrial intelligence; AI mid-platform links business/data/AI mid-platforms for smart marketing, supply chain, manufacturing.
